testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23076 invalid email format is rejected when creating a sales rep

scenario.summary: On Add Sales Rep the admin fills every mandatory field validly except Email Address, which gets an invalid format; Save shows an invalid-email message and the sales rep is not saved.
steps: On the Sales Rep listing click Add New.
Enter valid mandatory fields: store (@storeA.name), username, first name, last name (made up by the test).
Enter an invalid Email Address ('test@', then 'test.com').
assertions: An error message for the invalid email format is displayed at Email Address, for each invalid value
Saving is prevented: no sales rep with that username exists
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
Test case Z10-TC-23076 (AIO export): invalid examples 'test@' and 'test.com'.
FSD 'Create a Sales Rep': email format validation.
The message text is fixed by neither the case nor the FSD: the OOB text is read from the page and logged.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
